description: Source code for the NTLM client implementation, including message parsing, response generation, and security buffer management within the net::ntlm namespace.

classes.name: NtlmClient
classes.description: Class responsible for managing NTLM authentication messages, including generating negotiate and authenticate messages, parsing challenge messages, and handling security buffers.

methods.name: GetNegotiateMessage
methods.description: Returns the pre-generated NTLM negotiate message.

methods.name: GenerateNegotiateMessage
methods.description: Creates and stores the NTLM negotiate message.

methods.name: GenerateAuthenticateMessage
methods.description: Generates the NTLM authenticate message based on provided credentials, challenges, and context.

methods.name: CalculatePayloadLayout
methods.description: Calculates the layout of the payload buffers for the authenticate message.

methods.name: GetAuthenticateHeaderLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the authenticate message header, varies for NTLMv2.

methods.name: GetNtlmResponseLength
methods.description: Returns the total length of the NTLM response payload, depends on NTLM version.
